name: Job Search
description: Search job postings on LinkedIn (public listings, no login). action=daily runs EVERY search listed in a criteria file in one call and returns only the postings first seen today, without duplicates, plus the outcome of each search: use it for a scheduled run. action=search runs one search (one JSON line per posting, new = first seen today). action=detail returns the full description and the criteria of one posting.

action.description: daily = every search of the criteria file; search = one search; detail = full text of one posting

criteria_file.description: daily: absolute path of the criteria file (its '## Ricerche ...' section lists the searches)

keywords.description: search: job title or skills, e.g. "responsabile sviluppo software" or "AI engineer"

location.description: search: city or country, e.g. "Genova" or "Italia" (default Italia)

days.description: search: posted in the last N days, 1-30 (default 1). daily takes it from the criteria file

max_results.description: search/daily: maximum postings per search, 1-75 (default 25 for search, 20 for daily)

job_id.description: detail: the numeric id returned by search or daily
